key.name: favorite-session
key.description: The session whose workspace feeds the dashboard status. Set it by starring a session in the launcher menu.

key.name: dashboard-prompt
key.default: 'Summarize the current state of this workspace: what is in progress, what is open or overdue, and what needs attention next. Be concise, use short bullets. Read-only: do not create, edit, or delete any files. If nothing is configured here, say so plainly.'
key.description: Prompt sent to `codewhale exec` to generate the dashboard status.

key.name: dashboard-max-age
key.description: Regenerate the dashboard when the cached status is older than this, even if the workspace has not changed.
